name: Miyabi's Older Brother
source:
He is the big brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c12813]Miyabi[/url].

They were very close when they were little and played military together and camouflaged themselves.

[spoiler]He always supports his sister in all that she undertakes and she greatly respects him for that.[/spoiler]
